newsitem.title: CHILE: ING Barings grants Chile's VTR loan.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings grants Chile's VTR loan.

text.p: ING Barings and TD Securities said they have launched a $142.9 million secured loan facility to Chilean cable television company VTR Hipercable SA.
"The proceeds will be used to repay existing financial indebtedness and to finance capital expenditures," said the companies in a joint statement.
The loan is divided into two tranches. The first credit is a five-year $100 million loan, while the second is a $42.9 million loan which lasts for a year.
The second loan will be used to finance the central bank's reserve requirement rules which oblige firms to deposit 30 percent of new foreign capital with the bank for a year.
VTR Hipercable is Chile's largest pay television company and has plans to enter the local telephone business. VTR is owned by Chile's Luksic group and SBC Communications.
